G-Mode Archives 18: Hero Must Die. Director's Cut

An innovative RPG produced with Mr. Shoji Masuda for the original draft, scenario, and game design, Shunya Yamashita for character design, and Kenji Ito for music and gorgeous famous creators.
The hero who defeated the demon king and saved the world in exchange for his life went on a journey to find the woman he loved with five days of life expectancy. Time in the game passes according to the action, and as death approaches, the hero gradually loses his power...
A multi-scenario where you can experience new discoveries and new developments every time you play back. You can enjoy it as many times as you want due to the multi-ending where the content of the funeral changes depending on what you do before you live.

G-Mode Archives 31: Irekae IQ Crossword DX

Let's replace the letters and align the words!

A new sense of crossword puzzle that makes the pleasure of filling become a habit.

If you know the words that enter each square from the vertical and horizontal hints, replace the letters!

"Irekae IQ Crossword DX" is a crossword puzzle you play by replacing panels.

If multiple words are completed with a single replacement, you will get a high score!
In addition, the player's IQ level is judged according to the time required to clear and the score.
There are three types of game modes: "World Mode" that clears the stage within the time limit, "IQ Test Mode" that determines the player's IQ level, and "Free Mode" that solves problems without worrying about the time limit.

You can participate in each national ranking with your score and IQ index.

G-Mode Archives+: Ketsui - Kizuna Jigoku-tachi DX

The bonds I have with my friends will not let go even if I fall into hell. ``New authentic shooting'' where you fight with determination in your heart.

The year is 2054. Behind the endless wars is a company called ``EVAC Industry'' that exports weapons all over the world. The United Nations begins negotiations with EI, but EI completely rejects the proposal for a ``total ban on arms imports and exports.''
With no progress being made, the United Nations abandoned negotiations and secretly decided to intervene with force.

The mission is to ``destroy EI's weapons and development facilities'' and ``destroy everything related to UN military intervention.'' Even if the operation is successful, they will not be allowed to return home alive. There were four young people who volunteered for this harsh special mission.

Select an aircraft from two types of teams: TYPE-A (WAY SHOT type) and TYPE-B (LINEAR SHOT type). Normal bullets, lock shots, and bombs. Make full use of 3 types of attack methods and overwhelm the hell of barrage and weapons.

Also supports online rankings for each difficulty level. Take on the world with determination in your chest, even if you're willing to die.
G-Mode Archives 44: Dragon x Dragon
G-Mode Archives 44: Dragon x Dragon

Training × blending × combat. Explore the field and raise the strongest dragon!

"DRAGON x DRAGON" is an RPG that captures with three elements: training, blending, and combat.

In order to defeat the dark dragon "Genesis" that plunged the world into chaos, the boy "Willow", a descendant of the dragon messenger, grows up with his partner dragon "Kermes".

Choose your favorite field from among the many exploration destinations and set off on an adventure.

The items that can be acquired depending on the field and the attributes of the wild dragon you live in are different, so let's go deep into the field while consulting with the remaining physical strength of "Kermes" and the items you have on hand.

The young "Kermes" returns to "1" every time you return from the search destination, but you can strengthen your basic ability by mixing the items you got in the middle of the search and giving them to "Kermes".

The effect varies depending on the material to be blended. Try a wide variety of combinations and raise them to be the strongest dragon.
G-Mode Archives 48: Dragon x Dragon 2
G-Mode Archives 48: Dragon x Dragon 2

What is human charm? What is the truth contained in the holy flower pure bloom...

20 years after the story of DRAGON x DRAGON (Dragon x Dragon). "Seika Pure Brom" has been blooming all over the world since some time ago. The scent emitted from the petals heals people's troubles, seals the darkness that falls into the heart, and silence, innocence and "complete peace" come.

The Dark Dragon Genesis, which has reached its end, says, "In order to return to its original form, people must be released from Pure Brom someday."

The daughter of Willow, the main character of the previous work, "Adeku", embarks on a new adventure with the young dragon Lily.

Not only the characters from the previous work, but also the addition of new characters and enemy dragons has further increased the hit-in element.
Also, in this work, you can take over the level after returning from the dungeon, making it easier to play.

Adventure with the dragon and solve the mystery that sleeps in the ruins.
G-Mode Archives 51: Trio the Punch
G-Mode Archives 51: Trio the Punch

"Trio the Punch" is an arcade action game released by Data East in 1990.

Players choose one of the unique characters, such as "Santos" the tough guy, "Kamakura-kun" the ninja, and "Rosesub" the swordsman.

If you defeat the enemies in the stage and get a heart, and defeat the boss who appears by collecting all the hearts, you will clear the stage.

Of course, "Mr. Chin's roulette corner" is also alive and well.
If you draw a hit, you can benefit from increasing your HP and increasing your attack power, so let's push your eyes so that you can get a more effective bonus.

G-Mode Archives 58: Gekidan Musume Akane & Aoi

This compilation contains ports of two separate mobile games: Gekidan Musume: Akane and Gekidan Musume: Aoi. Both games are overhead sci-fi shooters with 3D graphics in which players shoot through a series of stages; those stages and enemies are shared between the two games, while each features a different playable character and a different storyline.
G-Mode Archives+: Monstre Waltz
G-Mode Archives+: Monstre Waltz

Monstre Waltz is an action RPG inspired by the Cthulhu Mythos.
Professor Norman Atkins, a magician and former explorer of otherworldly realms, fights using arcane magic.
Can he command circular magic and perform a waltz against unnamable monstrosities?
Together with a delicate girl who holds the key to the tale, he challenges the sealed labyrinth.
G-Mode Archives+: Flash Motor Karen
G-Mode Archives+: Flash Motor Karen

Flash Motor Karen is an action puzzle game in the style of Sokoban.
While puzzles are the core of the gameplay, it also features an excellent story.
A cool world setting, a wonderful narrative, and unique characters define its charm.

G-Mode Archives+: Lost Chronicle

This is an original JRPG created exclusively for mobile devices by Bandai Namco Entertainment.

Embark on your adventure by choosing from six elements — Fire, Wind, Earth, Water, Dark, and Light — and a wide range of jobs, including Fencer, Scout, Mage, and Cleric.

G-Mode Archives+: Kishinden Strike-G-

This title is a simulation RPG, originally released for Japanese flip phone application, in which players control robots. The story unfolds through lively exchanges between a colorful cast of characters, with a scenario by Hachirō Izumi.

Embark on your adventure by choosing from six elements — Fire, Wind, Earth, Water, Dark, and Light — and a wide range of jobs, including Fencer, Scout, Mage, and Cleric.
